text:
Elaine (Product): Quick sync in 30m? Need to lock gating rules + launch criteria for the new Export add-on (regional egress, per-file token caps). Who can join? :calendar:

Mike (Eng): I can. Important: exports touch bulk IO + network egress. We need clear fallback to streamed/export-lite to avoid overload.

Sophia (Sales): Customer ask: Acme and ByteWave want 'unlimited' exports in contract drafts. We should define exception flow. @Elaine please. :eyes:

Samir (Legal): Heads-up — cross-border egress has contract & DPA implications. We'll need opt-in checkbox and audit log retained for 7 years for certain customers.

Anna (Finance): Pricing thought: start $0.02/MB with commit discounts, or $X/month for unlimited pilot. Also consider rounding rules for partial MBs.

Gina (DevEx): Rollout criteria idea: pilot with 3 customers, success = <2% export failures, 95p latency <2s for small files (<1MB), and no >10% increase in infra cost per customer.

Mike (Eng): Perf constraints: exports that hit long-tail seqs will blow up KV cache. Suggest per-file token cap default 500k tokens and a per-account daily export quota. Fallback flow should return a downloadable gzipped JSON with manifest.

Elaine (Product): That sounds reasonable. We need product gating fields: region allowlist, per-file cap, per-account daily quota, contract exception flag. Also need clear admin UI to toggle per-customer.

Gina (DevEx): Suggested config snippet for rollout (for ops):
```yaml
export_addon:
  enabled_by_default: false
  per_file_token_cap: 500000
  per_account_daily_tokens: 5000000
  allowed_regions: [us, eu]
  fallback: export-lite
```

Sophia (Sales): For enterprise deals: we can allow region exceptions but charge a premium and require SOC2 + DPA signed. Acme will pay for exceptions.

Samir (Legal): Confirming: exceptions must have signed amendment and explicit audit retention clause. No ad-hoc exceptions without paper trail.

Anna (Finance): Also propose soft-launch pricing floor for pilot to gather usage signals: $500/mo for pilot seat + usage. We can add a clause that when commit threshold hit, they move to committed discount tiers.

Mike (Eng): Ops notes: autoscale for export workers will need a separate cap to prevent noisy neighbor. Add quota throttle at routing layer + circuit breaker.

policy-bot: policy check: export_addon requires SOC2 AND customer_export_opt_in. Flagged items: audit_retention missing in config.

Gina (DevEx): Good catch. Add audit_retention: 7y and export_opt_in: true to the rollout config.

Elaine (Product): Next steps I propose: 1) Agree gating defaults (use Gina's YAML with audit_retention), 2) Pricing draft from Anna to share with sales by EOD, 3) Legal to draft exception amendment template, 4) Eng to spec fallback and circuit breaker. I'll run a 30m sync. :thumbsup:

Sophia (Sales): I'll bring Acme/ByteWave as pilot prospects.

Mike (Eng): I'll sketch the fallback flow and routing throttle today.

Samir (Legal): I'll draft amendment template and list required DPA verbiage.

Anna (Finance): I'll send the pilot pricing and commit tiers.

Gina (DevEx): I'll add telemetry events and dashboards for pilot success metrics.

Elaine (Product): Thanks everyone — meeting in 25m.
